claimRefund(address).details: Returns user's locked cost during trial period

params.adjudicator: Address that can settle the market
params.adjudicatorAgentId: ERC-8004 agent ID for validated adjudicator (0 to skip)
params.adjudicatorMinValidators: Min validators for validated adjudicator (0 to skip)
params.question: Market question

returns.lpTokens: Initial LP tokens minted to creator

dismissMarket(address).details: Sets isDismissed flag, allowing users to claim refunds

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.maxCostOrMinProceeds: For buys: max cost (including fees); for sells: min proceeds

returns.actualCost: Actual cost paid (buys) or proceeds received (sells)

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

dismissMarket(address).notice: Dismiss a market during trial period (creator only)

tradePositions(address,uint8,int256,uint.notice: Trade positions with automatic fee distribution

userLockedCost(address,address).notice: User's locked cost per market (for refund calculation)

userTrialBalance(address,address).notice: User's trial balance per market (net P&L during trial)
